title: The step: Compliance certificates section, optional, with its (i)
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save. Also add a compliance service 'CVIP' (12-month term) with canned lines.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
  6. Press Add Service > Add on PM-A and on CVIP. Complete every line on the Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Finance tab and press Create Invoice.
  2. In When was the maintenance done? find the Compliance certificates section and hover its (i).
  3. For CVIP enter Number C-448210, Start date today and Term 12 months; read End date.
  4. Press Add another certificate and read what appears; then remove or leave it empty.
  5. Press Confirm dates and record the payment. Open the asset's Maintenance tab and read CVIP.
  6. On a second identical work order, invoice again but leave the certificate section empty; press Confirm dates.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The step carries a Compliance certificates section for CVIP, one record per inspection: type, number, Start date, End date and term.
  • Its (i) explains it (in the design: “Optional. End date fills in from Start date plus the term. A certificate is valid through its End date. The next due comes from the certificate.”).
  • End date fills in as today plus 12 months.
  • Add another certificate offers a further record (design label).
  • After confirming, CVIP's next due comes from the certificate's End date.
  • Leaving the section empty is allowed: the section is optional.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S18; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboards I6 / I7; read 6 Oct 2026.
